caption: The drawing depicts a closed, rectangular trunk with a curved top, rendered in shades of brown, tan, and black. The trunk’s body is predominantly brown, suggesting a wooden or leather material, and is reinforced by several black, slightly metallic-looking bands that run vertically along the trunk's sides and lid, each secured with round, gold-colored studs. The trunk has a central horizontal leather strap with a buckle and a brass padlock placed in the center front, below a small brass plate. Additional brown leather straps, equipped with buckles and fasteners, wrap around the trunk vertically and horizontally. The surface of the trunk shows detailed textures, with visible stitching and natural wear patterns in the illustration. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects present.
title: Large Trunk
